sentences.text:
1. Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
2. Petitioners seek quashing of case FIR No. 224/2015 of PS Karawal Nagar for offence under Section 498A/406/34 IPC and Section 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act on the ground that the complainant de facto (respondent no.2) has compromised the disputes with the petitioners.
3. The IO/ASI Vikram Singh submits that despite his repeated requests, the present petitioners have not provided him death certificate of mother of petitioner no. 1.
But learned APP appearing through videoconferencing This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.

The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 04/04/2026 at 20:35:16 submits that not only the death certificate was supplied but the same has even been verified and verification report is already on record.
It seems that the IO/ASI Vikram Singh is not aware of the matter.
Learned APP for State also expresses anguish that the IO did not brief him.

4. Be that as it may, since parties have not appeared today, in view of nature of these proceedings,
matter be listed for recording of statement of parties before the concerned Joint Registrar on 20.05.2026.
